# CustomMapLibreLayer

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Define a custom MapLibre GL layer with WebGL rendering. The code must return an object with onAdd, render, and onRemove methods. Access parameters via `params` object and map instance via `map`.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/custom-map-libre-layer",
  "type": "CustomMapLibreLayerOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/custom-map-libre-layer').par.id` (an input) and `op('/custom-map-libre-layer').out.layer` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.id`, `out.layer`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `id` | `StringField` | `"custom-layer"` |
| `code` | `CodeField` | `""` |
| `renderingMode` | `StringLiteralField` | `"3d"` |
| `beforeId` | `StringField` | `""` |
| `params` | `UnknownField` | `{}` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->

<!-- gen:end outputs -->
